disabled.title: Evaluation is not enabled
disabled.description: This deployment has not switched on run tracking, so no experiments can run against this Bot.

empty.title: No experiments yet
empty.description: Submitted experiments and their per-sample results appear here.

forbidden.title: You cannot view this Bot's experiments
forbidden.description: Experiments belong to the Bot's creator and administrators; access to the Bot is not enough.

basic.title: Executed at basic level
basic.description: The samples ran through the basic observation path: what passed through OpenBot is recorded, the runtime's internal steps are not.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: Part of this experiment's input, output or score rationale was withheld by the redaction policy.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: Part of this experiment's content exceeded the field limit and was cut short; the full content was never stored.

syncing.title: Results are still syncing
syncing.description: Finished samples reach this page shortly after scoring completes; give it a moment.

unavailable.title: Experiments are unavailable
unavailable.description: The evaluation service could not be reached, so experiments cannot be shown right now. Running or queued tasks are not lost.
